SecurityGroupEgress.Description: Allow all outbound traffic by default

Fn::Join:
version: 1.1
tasks:
  - task: initializeVolume
    inputs:
      initialize: devices
      devices:
        - device: xvdf
          name: Data
          letter: D
  - task: setHostName
    inputs:
      hostName: cdk-integ
      reboot: false
  - task: setWallpaper
    inputs:
      path: C:\ProgramData\Amazon\EC2Launch\wallpaper\Ec2Wallpaper.jpg
      attributes:
        - instanceId
      instanceTags: AllTags
  - task: startSsm
  - task: writeFile
    inputs:
      - frequency: once
        destination: C:\cdk-integ-write-file.txt
        content: written by writeFile
  - task: executeProgram
    inputs:
      - frequency: once
        path: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe
        arguments:
          - /c
          - mkdir
          - C:\cdk-integ-execute-program
        runAs: localSystem
  - task: executeScript
    inputs:
      - frequency: once
        type: batch
        runAs: localSystem
        content: echo batch> C:\cdk-integ-batch.txt
      - frequency: once
        type: powershell
        runAs: admin
        arguments:
          - -NoProfile
          - -ExecutionPolicy
          - Unrestricted
        content: |-
          if (-not (Test-Path -Path 'C:\cdk-integ-batch.txt')) { throw 'batch script did not run first' }
          Set-Content -Path 'C:\cdk-integ-powershell.txt' -Value powershell
      - frequency: once
        type: powershell
        runAs: localSystem
        detach: true
        content: Write-Output detached
      - frequency: once
        type: powershell
        runAs: localSystem
        content: |2-
          $success = $true
          $finished = $false
          try {
          if (-not (Test-Path -Path 'D:\')) { throw 'initializeVolume task did not run' }
          if (-not (Test-Path -Path 'C:\cdk-integ-powershell.txt')) { throw 'PowerShell script did not run before the commands' }
          if (-not (Test-Path -Path 'C:\cdk-integ-execute-program' -PathType Container)) { throw 'executeProgram task did not run' }
          if ((Get-Content -Path 'C:\cdk-integ-write-file.txt' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -ne 'written by writeFile') { throw 'writeFile task did not run' }
          $finished = $true
          } catch {
          $success = $false
          $finished = $true
          throw
          } finally {
          if ($finished) {
          cfn-signal --stack integ-userdata-ec2launch-v2 --resource InstanceC1063A87 --region
